paths.name: Path of The Trollslayer
paths.description: A mastery path focused on longer-duration battles

ability.name: Power Through
ability.description: Exhaustive Blows will no longer remove your Rage, but being Furious no longer grants Exhaustive Blows any additional effects.

ability.name: Rampage
ability.note:
Must be Furious or Berserk
Exhausts up to 50 Rage
ability.description: For the next 10 seconds, your attacks are 100% less likely to be Blocked or Parried. If you are Furious, the duration is increased to 20 seconds.

ability.name: Fierce Might
ability.description: As you get closer to death and redemption, your rage fills you with power.  Your critical bonus damage is increased by 10%, for 2 seconds, for every 10% of hit points that you have lost.

ability.name: Deep Wound
ability.description: You slash at your enemy, dealing 178 damage and reducing the value of incoming healing on them by 50% for 10 seconds.

ability.name: Short Temper
ability.description: While Berserk, hitting an enemy with a Path of the Trollslayer ability reduces all your active cooldowns by 1 second.

ability.name: Rune of Absorption
ability.description: A merciless string of attacks that repeatedly hit your target for 269 damage up to 6 times over the next 5 seconds. You will be healed for all the damage that this ability deals.

ability.name: Unleashed Power
ability.description: You unleash a wave of power, causing groupmates' attacks to deal an additional 300 damage for 10 seconds while within 100 feet of you.

coreAbilities.name: Slow Down
coreAbilities.description: You deal 178 damage and reduce the movement speed of your enemy by 40% for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Relentless Strike
coreAbilities.description: You strike at your opponent, immediately inflicting 145 damage. The wound continues to bleed for 180 damage for the next 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Spine Crusher
coreAbilities.note: Target must be facing away from you
coreAbilities.description: You deal 253 damage to your enemy.

coreAbilities.name: Fierceness
coreAbilities.description: For the next 10 seconds, group member's within 100 feet will have their Weaponskill increased by 33 each time that you hit an enemy with direct damage, and your Toughness will be reduced by 33. This effect can be stacked up to three times.

coreAbilities.name: Enervating Blow
coreAbilities.note:
Must be Furious or Berserk
Exhausts up to 100 Rage
coreAbilities.description:
You deal an exhaustive blow that does 178 damage and reduces your target's chance to critically hit by 100% for 10 seconds.

If you are Furious, gains a 75% damage bonus instead of the 25% bonus.

paths.name: Path of The Giantslayer
paths.description: A mastery path focused on dealing quick exhaustive blows

ability.name: Determination
ability.description: Your Exhaustive blows now exhaust 15 Rage less when used while Furious.

ability.name: Cleft In Twain
ability.description:
You attack your target with a devastating blow, dealing 178 damage and applying a debuff for 6 seconds when the debuff ends you will strike the target again, dealing 216 damage. Hitting the target with an Exhaustive Blow consumes the debuff immediately and delivers the second hit after a 1 second delay.

If you are wielding a Great Weapon, you will gain 10 Rage the first time Cleft in Twain deals damage and 20 Rage the second time Cleft in Twain deals damage.

ability.name: Violent Impacts
ability.description: Your Exhaustive Blows will ignore 25% of the targets armor if used while Furious.

ability.name: Devastate
ability.note:
Requires Great Weapon
Must be Furious or Berserk
Exhausts up to 35 Rage
ability.description:
You devastate your target, dealing 328 damage and reducing your target's Wounds by 150 for 10 seconds.

If you are Furious, gains a 75% damage bonus instead of the 25% bonus.

ability.name: Breaking Point
ability.description: Hitting an enemy with Devastate or Incapacitate will make your next Exhaustive Blow within 5 seconds automatically critically hit.

ability.name: Spellbreaker
ability.note:
Requires Great Weapon
Must be Furious or Berserk
Exhausts up to 50 Rage
ability.description:
A shattering strike which deals 291 damage and will remove one damage absorbing effect, and one Enchantment or Blessing from the target. Any effects removed from the target will inflict an additional 225 damage.

If you are Furious, gains a 75% damage bonus instead of the 25% bonus and build 20 Rage for each effect removed.

ability.name: Looks Like a Challenge
ability.description: You deal 1200 damage to targets within 25 feet  and debuff incoming healing by 50% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Pulverizing Strike
coreAbilities.description: A furious slash that deals 216 damage and reduces your target's Toughness by 50 for 9 seconds. This effect is stackable up to three times.

coreAbilities.name: Precarious Assault
coreAbilities.note:
Must be Furious or Berserk
Exhausts up to 35 Rage
coreAbilities.description:
A reckless attack which deals 291 damage to your target.

If you are Furious, gains a 75% damage bonus instead of the 25% bonus and deal 337 damage to yourself.

coreAbilities.name: Deathblow
coreAbilities.note:
Requires Great Weapon
Must be Furious or Berserk
Exhausts up to 100 Rage
coreAbilities.description:
You unleash a powerful blow, dealing 441 damage. This ability exhausts 10% less Rage for each 10% health that the target is missing.

If you are Furious, gains a 75% damage bonus instead of the 25% bonus.

coreAbilities.name: Reckless Gamble
coreAbilities.description: While this ability is active, each time you strike a target with a melee attack, you will deal an additional 150 damage, but you will also suffer 75 damage each time this happens.

coreAbilities.name: Incapacitate
coreAbilities.description: You render an incapacitating blow to your target, dealing 216 damage and knocking them down for 3 seconds. This attack is undefendable.

paths.name: Path of The Skavenslayer
paths.description: A mastery path focused on area of effect offensive abilities

ability.name: Takin' Chances
ability.description: While you are Furious, you regain 150 health every 4 seconds. While you are Berserk, you regain 262 health every 4 seconds.

ability.name: No Escape
ability.note:
Requires Dual Wield
Must be Furious or Berserk
Exhausts up to 50 Rage
ability.description:
A crippling blow, dealing 142 damage to all enemies within 25 feet. The victims will all become snared, reducing their run speed by 30% for 5 seconds.

If you are Furious, gains a 75% damage bonus instead of the 25% bonus.

ability.name: Accuracy
ability.description: Flurry will now hit up to 24 targets within 30 feet in front of you, but its damage is reduced by 15%.

ability.name: Shatter Limbs
ability.description: You brutally crush all enemies within 25 feet, dealing 105 damage. Your merciless display of savagery intimidates your enemy, increasing their cooldown timers by 3 seconds for 10 seconds.

ability.name: Runic Blessings
ability.description: When you fall in battle, your Ancestors intervene, temporarily resurrecting you with 25% health and resetting all your cooldowns. If you manage to kill an enemy within 10 seconds, you get to live on to find your glorious death elsewhere. If not, you will die once again. You cannot be resurrected by this effect more than once every 60 seconds.

ability.name: Inevitable Doom
ability.description: You deal 115 damage to your target and force them to share your doomed fate, inflicting a dark rune on them. The rune will explode every 2 seconds and will keep exploding for anywhere between 4 seconds to 8 seconds, dealing 121 damage to all enemies within 25 feet. The main target takes 50% of the explosion damage.

ability.name: Doom Seeker
ability.description: You deal 1800 damage and knock down targets within 25 feet for 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flurry
coreAbilities.description: You wildly swing in front of you,  dealing 194 damage to up to three enemies within 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Wild Swing
coreAbilities.note:
Must be Furious or Berserk
Exhausts up to 100 Rage
coreAbilities.description:
You wildly attack everything around you, each enemy that you hit within 25 feet suffers 231 damage. You gain 5 Rage for each enemy hit, up to a maximum of 9 targets.

If you are Furious, gains a 75% damage bonus instead of the 25% bonus.

coreAbilities.name: Even the Odds
coreAbilities.description: For the next 5 seconds, you cannot deal or receive critical damage.

coreAbilities.name: Onslaught
coreAbilities.description: You swipe at the enemies in front of you, dealing 444 damage over 9 seconds to enemies within 40 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Retribution
coreAbilities.description: For the next 5 seconds you strike out at all enemies 25 feet in front of you, inflicting 231 damage every second. While Berserk, Retribution additionally deals 269 damage back to the attacker each time you are hit with an attack, this effect can only be triggered once every second.

coreAbilities.name: Bypass Defenses
coreAbilities.description: You bolster yourself for 10 seconds, allowing you to bypass the defenses of an enemy keep's postern door, porting you inside.

coreAbilities.name: Siege Wrecker
coreAbilities.description: You sabotage a siege ram, causing the ram to deal 98% of the original damage for the next 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Faultfinder
coreAbilities.description: Increases friendly ram damage by 2% for the next 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Throw Axe
coreAbilities.description: A basic throwing attack that inflicts 82 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Charge!
coreAbilities.description: You charge into the thick of battle, increasing your movement speed by 50% for 7 seconds.  If you use any abilities, the effect will immediately end.

coreAbilities.name: Distracting Roar
coreAbilities.description: All enemies within 25 feet are detaunted, making them hate you less and reducing the damage they deal against you to 50% for 5 seconds. During this time, all of your attacks will cause enemies to hate you 25% less than normal. You will also deal 50% damage to them until the effect is broken. If you attack anyone you have detaunted, the effect will immediately end.

coreAbilities.name: Sever Nerve
coreAbilities.description: A directed strike that inflicts 1200 damage to your target.

coreAbilities.name: Stoutness of Stone
coreAbilities.description: Increases Toughness by 80. You also recover from Stuns, Staggers and Knockdowns 1 seconds quicker. You will still gain immunity based on the original duration.

coreAbilities.name: Break Loose
coreAbilities.description: Your mounting rage allows you to firm your Dwarven resolve and remove all roots and snares from you.  For the next 10 seconds, roots and snares will have no effect on you.

coreAbilities.name: Gudrun's Warcry
coreAbilities.description: Your groupmates are inspired by your eagerness to fight. Your group's abilities cost 25% fewer Action Points for 20 seconds while within 100 feet of you.

coreAbilities.name: Force of Will
coreAbilities.description: You stare down your opponent, draining 200 of their Action Points into yourself, and reducing their Strength by 160 for 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Jagged Edge
coreAbilities.description: Any time you critically hit an enemy they will begin to bleed, suffering additional 513 Corporeal damage over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Wild Gambit
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Strength and Weapon Skill by 120, but reduces your Toughness by 120.

coreAbilities.name: Numbing Strike
coreAbilities.note: Requires Target to have Parried or Blocked
coreAbilities.description: You land a numbing blow, reducing your target's chance to block or parry by 50% for 10 seconds. This attack cannot be defended against.

coreAbilities.name: Brute Force
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Strength by 160.

coreAbilities.name: Confusing Movements
coreAbilities.description: Concentrating on your perceived movements, you will be able to Dodge and Parry all attacks against you for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Stubbornness
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Corporeal resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Relentless Assault
coreAbilities.description: A prolonged fervor that grants 10 Action Points a second to everyone in your group within 100 feet of you for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Hastened Punishment
coreAbilities.description: Cooldowns on your Exhaustive Attacks are reduced by 25%.

coreAbilities.name: Ancestral Inheritance
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Armor by 660.

coreAbilities.name: Overpowering Blow
coreAbilities.description: You strike your opponent with surprising force, dealing 1200 damage and knocking them down for 4 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flanking
coreAbilities.description:
All of your attacks deal 15% more damage when you strike an enemy from the sides or rear.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Close Combat
coreAbilities.description: Any time you strike an enemy in melee with a direct attack, you will receive 25% less damage from ranged and magical attacks for 2 seconds. This effect will not guard or detaunt abilities.

coreAbilities.name: Honor Restored
coreAbilities.description: Whenever you exhaust Rage with an attack, you are healed for 15 health per point of Rage exhausted.

coreAbilities.name: Untouchable
coreAbilities.description: Your chance to defend attacks is increased by 100% for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Riposte
coreAbilities.description: Each time you parry an enemy's attack, you will strike them back for 253 damage which they can not prevent.

coreAbilities.name: Invigorating Release
coreAbilities.description: Your Exhaustive Abilities now remove one movement impairing effect from yourself. You gain 40 Action Points each time an effect is removed. This cannot happen more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Deadly Determination
coreAbilities.description: You deal an additional 300 damage, whenever you use an ability. This effect will fade after you damage 8 targets.

coreAbilities.name: Got No Time For You
coreAbilities.description: All Taunts and Detaunts are 25% less effective against you.

coreAbilities.name: Slaughter
coreAbilities.description: Your Action Point costs are reduced by 5 points while Furious and 10 points while Berserk.

coreAbilities.name: Grievous Harm
coreAbilities.description: You deal 1800 damage and debuff the target's outgoing damage to 75% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Push For More
coreAbilities.description: Your autoattack speed is increased by 25% while you are Furious and 50% while you are Berserk.

coreAbilities.name: Embrace the Pain
coreAbilities.description: Each time you take critical damage, your Strength is increased by 120 and your chance to critically hit is increased by 5% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Frenzied Slaughter
coreAbilities.description: All of your abilities will cost 25% fewer action points, cool down 50% faster, and deal 20% more damage for 7 seconds.
